## Project Details

Dominion Energy is proposing a new substation and transmission line project in Fairfax County to meet the area's growing electrical needs. The project will support new data center development while helping provide reliable electric service for local homes, businesses and communities. The Virginia State Corporation Commission approved the transmission line portion of the project in August 2025. The Edsall Substation is currently going through the local permitting process. Explore maps, visual simulations, project updates, timelines and opportunities to provide feedback.

[SCC Final Order\\
![cta btn](https://cdn-dominionenergy-prd-001.azureedge.net/assets/images/arrowcta.svg?v=20260811085030)](https://cdn-dominionenergy-prd-001.azureedge.net/-/media/content/about/power-line-projects/edsall/pdfs/edsall-scc-final-order.pdf?rev=11caab4f47314681aef6d41c2bf2f2ae)

### Benefits

- Complies with mandatory standards to ensure safety, reliability and to meet future needs.
- Minimizes impact to the community and environment.
- Strengthens area reliability.

## Substation Noise Tool App

As your community grows, you may see new high-voltage power lines or substations being built to help maintain a strong, reliable electric grid. Substations play an important role in safely delivering electricity by adjusting voltage, managing power flow, and protecting the grid. Some of the equipment inside substations produces noise during normal operation, which may occasionally be heard outside the facility.

**The Substation Impact Tool lets you:**

- Learn what causes substation noise.
- See how sound moves through a typical substation area.
- Better understand what you might hear in real life situations.

[Explore the Tool](https://www.dominionenergy.com/en/About/Delivering-Energy/Electric-Projects/Power-Line-Projects/substation-impact-tool-noise)

## Legal

The [Virginia State Corporation](https://scc.virginia.gov/) (SCC) has regulatory authority over all energy providers in Virginia. Among other responsibilities, the SCC validates the need for a proposed line and approves the route and structures. In reviewing a proposed project, the SCC must consider whether potential impacts on scenic assets, historic districts and the environment have been reasonably minimized. On July 26, 2024, Dominion Energy filed its application with the SCC. The SCC issued its Final Order approving the project on August 8, 2025.

Documents related to the case are available to the public on the [SCC Docket of the SCC website](https://scc.virginia.gov/docketsearch#/caseDetails/145356/) or search by Case No. PUR-2024-001
35 in the [Search Cases](https://scc.virginia.gov/docketsearch/) section. In addition, interested parties may visit the [SCC Case Comments Page](https://scc.virginia.gov/case-information/submit-public-comments/) where individual mailboxes are available for each accepting public comments.
